brief:
Tens of thousands of Palestinians performed Friday prayers at the Al-Aqsa Mosque despite heightened Israeli military presence and restrictions, Shehab Wire reported. Israeli forces deployed extensively throughout the compound and tightened measures at entrances to the Old City as worshippers gathered.

The prayers took place amid ongoing restrictions on access to the mosque, a flashpoint site in Jerusalem's Old City that has witnessed repeated confrontations between Palestinians and Israeli forces.
